name: Composite Cross Domain Variant 3
task:
Please complete the following four-stage multi-domain task.

A hospital's annual review (20 pages): 500 beds, occupancy 85%, 3 departments. Expansion proposals: ER ($2M, 20% more patients), ICU ($3M, 15% more), Pediatrics ($1M, 10% more). Budget: $4M.

Calculate NPV of the investment.

Optimize budget allocation.

Recommend the best course of action.
